### 2. Your role

Access advice from written instruction/agreed inputs to named final output and response-round end. Architect/specialists retain design; BCA adviser coordinates code; independent statutory certifier decides approval. No approval or discrimination-immunity guarantee.
Dated PDFs/mark-ups and editable issues, assumptions, solutions and evidence registers; locations, input revisions, owners/dates and closure proof. Coordinate architecture, landscape/civil, services/AV, lifts, fire, BCA and operator.

### 3. Scope by stage

Select base, options and end boundary; advice-only ends at its report/response round. Later work needs written activation. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Inception / evidence | Agree brief/basis; inspect agreed existing routes, separate observed/measured/reported facts; route map/photos, inaccessible areas, upgrade questions and prioritised actions |
| S2 Concept advice | Mark access-chain barriers/options: arrival/parking, entries/levels, routes, lifts and facilities; flag solution candidates and required versus voluntary improvements |
| S4 Construction approval | Review conditions and coordinated drawings/specs; preliminary mark-ups/final access report, close earlier findings and schedule product/measurement evidence. Solution preparation separate |
| S5 Tender support (option) | Review agreed tender access documents and counted queries; D&C design-intent/contractor duties explicit. Access review does not prepare architectural design. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S6 Post-contract review (option) | Separately appointed contractor details/substitutions: tactile indicators, doors, fixtures, signs/lifts; effects on earlier reports/solutions and reassessment. No automatic novation. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S7 Construction / completion (option) | Counted hold-point visits, pre-final/final audits and close-out; location/photos, test/product/as-built evidence and solution conditions. Qualified opinion only for inspected scope; outstanding gaps explicit; certifier decides occupation. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S8 Advisory / operational (option) | Defined audit/inclusive brief: sampling, evidence cutoff, user consultation, sensory/cognitive needs, priorities/actions and operator commitments. Operational plan cannot replace physical compliance or accepted solution. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 4. Allowances

Complete quantities or authorised assumption with owner/date/consequence. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate/quantity; base/options and standalone/package dependencies separate.

|---|---|---|---|
| Coverage | 2 buildings/uses/floors/units/routes/sample areas; measured versus visual evidence, inaccessible areas and safe-access provider | Reviews / reports | 2 packages/rounds by stage; preliminary/final mark-ups, draft/final reports, client and authority responses |
| Meetings / RFIs | 2 meetings by stage/duration/location; RFI hour ceiling and tender period. Reconcile stage counts/concessions and disclose conflicting totals | Solution options | 2 departures/groups, briefs/reports, consultations/revisions, independent review and completion checks |
| Tests / visits | 2 visits allocated by selected stage: inspections/pre-final/final/revisits/handovers; separate test methods/locations/quantities/provider, equipment and certificate gaps | Duration / extras | 2 months; travel/out-of-hours, delay/remobilisation/cancellation; extra review/meeting/visit/departure units |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Access review against confirmed basis at appointed stages only; Retained/new work and affected routes; BCA/certifier assess obligations, no automatic whole-building upgrade or exemption; Mixed uses/buildings/tenancies: continuous routes, shared entries/lifts/amenities; resolve adjoining-property/tenancy reliance; Hearing/signage/tactile/lift/facility criteria review; services/AV designs hearing, architect signs, lift specialist lifts; Occupied/staged route-continuity review at appointed stages; repeat audits only within selected visit/stage allowances; contractor methods/safety, operator management.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Performance departure: brief/method/report/revisions per departure; author/independent assessor, fire/egress interfaces and acceptance/completion conditions; Luminance/slip tests: competent named provider, installed-product certificates and field-test extent separately priced; Beyond-minimum inclusive/user/operational brief, sensory/cognitive needs and action plan; owner training/ongoing management; Remediation/heritage access options from specialist diagnosis/advice; no structural/fire/conservation/hazardous-material design; Independent peer review/expert evidence: independence, reliance and legal instruction; no transfer of design duty.
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Engagement under attached Project access appointment (attached), agreed schedules, numbered addenda and written acceptance; settle precedence/departures. No commencement, boilerplate or correspondence silently settles conflicts or activates work.
- Written authority before extra scope, overrun, rate/fee/time change: reason, output, price and program effect. Agree law/interpretation changes, delays and staged releases against baseline.
- Sign-off records baseline; agreed design development/routine coordination remain included. Inputs need revisions/owners/dates; missing evidence/access promptly flagged.
- Correct own errors without extra fee. Reasonable professional skill/care within competence; evidence limits do not waive agreed responsibilities.
- Payment 30 days after correct invoice for agreed services; GST/stage milestones separate. Declare deposits, final-report release, interest and suspension departures.
- State fixed rate period and proposed changes; disclose travel, portals/invoice formats, cancellation/remobilisation before appointment; no hidden uplift.
- Valid 90 days; reconcile conflicting offered validity, program, meeting and liability terms. Missing agreement or revised attachment is not acceptance.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; scope answers as numbered addenda to all tenderers; acknowledge each.
- Agree project/team/authority/operator use and explicit third-party reliance, editable files/retention/handover and confidentiality. R6 declares caps/time bars, indemnities, IP limits, caveat/security and retrospective terms; agree law/disputes/cure/termination.

### 7. Evaluation

Evaluated price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Named team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equivalent stages, counts, evidence and dependencies before price; DA, design and completion appointments differ. Lowest fee need not win.
